title: Role of Various Electro-Tablets in Flight Deck and Fuselage
content: The flight operations inside the cockpit and fuselage are moving towards technological based systems, such as Tablets and Mobile computers. The new technology also offers a variety of possible options to pick the right tools and gadgets for regular operations performed by the Pilot, inside the Cockpit and in the fuselage. This paper surveys different gadgets, Electronic Flight Bag (EFB) used by the aviation pilots as well as Inflight Entertainment Devices (IFE) used in the aviation industry. Moreover, the present work also surveys the variety of gadgets used to achieve various goals with the existing issues and challenges.
